hexa.notes: THIS IS THE HOLE FOR WIND ARCHER. Beyond the three opening steps above, no usable public GMS HEXA investment order could be sourced. What was checked and why each failed: (a) the Wind Archer class doc does have a Sixth Job section, but the doc's own header says it was last updated 2023-11-23 and its content there is two images with no accompanying text; (b) Grandis Library's 'HEXA Tracker' link on the Wind Archer page points at a Google Sheet that now returns HTTP 410 Gone, i.e. it has been deleted; (c) Grandis Library's own class page has no HEXA section at all, only the infographic image; (d) the infographic itself is roughly 180 icon cells with level numbers and no text labels past the first three, and transcribing it by icon matching was judged too error-prone to record here — a human or OCR pass on https://www.grandislibrary.com/class-infographic/wind-archer/wind-archer-6th-job.png is the cheapest way to recover the full order. Mechanical facts that do hold: HEXA nodes cap at level 30 with final-damage jumps at levels 10, 20 and 30; HEXA Enhancement nodes require the matching V skill to be maxed and equipped; Mastery Skills are affected by Hyper Skill passives and by the boost-node enhancement on the base skill (so a levelled Song of Heaven Boost also improves HEXA Song of Heaven). Current Wind Archer HEXA judgement lives in the class Discord (https://discord.gg/4pbZMeThgP).

hyperStats.notes: No class-specific hyper stat order could be sourced, and one of the two sources that addresses it declines to give one on purpose. The Wind Archer class doc states that hyper stats are extremely character- and account-dependent and tells the reader to fill out a character calculator instead of following a list. NamuWiki's Wind Archer page has no hyper stat section. That refusal is itself the finding worth encoding: the community's operative answer to hyper stat priority is a per-character computation (MathBro's Hyper Stat Optimizer, https://brendonmay.github.io/hyperCalculator/), not a fixed ranking. A static list here would be an invention.

gearingNotes:
Four things change gearing advice for Wind Archer specifically.

1. CRIT RATE DOES NOT STOP MATTERING AT 100%. Wind Archer has the archer skill Vicious Shot, which for 30 seconds lets critical rate exceed 100% and converts critical rate into critical damage (at max level, critical damage increases by 50% of critical rate). Grandis Library's base-stat table lists that conversion as one of the class's crit damage sources. So crit rate above the normal 100% cap still converts to damage inside the burst window, and crit rate should not be treated as a stat to hard-cap. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills (Vicious Shot description), grandislibrary.com Wind Archer base stats.

2. ATTACK SPEED IS ALREADY CAPPED FROM PASSIVES. Agile Bows gives +2 attack speed, Eagle Eye +1 and Albatross Max +1 on top of the bow's base stage. NamuWiki states outright that Wind Archer can reach maximum attack speed from its own skills. Consequence: no attack speed inner ability line, and no need to slot Decent Speed Infusion for the attack speed. NamuWiki adds that Song of Heaven, the bossing main attack, is not affected by attack speed at all. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills, en.namu.wiki Wind Archer.

3. COOLDOWN REDUCTION IS WORTH MORE THAN USUAL. NamuWiki flags Wind Archer as cooldown-dependent because Howling Gale, a short-cooldown skill, carries a large share of both sustained and burst damage, and says burst and sustain both drop if cooldown reduction is insufficient. The class doc agrees in the other direction: it says a -4 second cooldown hat is optimal for damage, while a -2 second hat does not beat a stat hat of 30% or more. Sources: en.namu.wiki Wind Archer, Wind Archer FAQ doc.

4. NO ARROW COST, AND A JEWEL SECONDARY. Sylvan Aid lets Wind Archer use skills without consuming arrows, so arrow supply is not a constraint; the class doc still suggests Titanium Arrows for the flat attack. The secondary weapon is a Jewel, which NamuWiki notes cannot be scroll-enhanced but can take potential; the emblem is the Cygnus gold emblem and is untradeable. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills, Wind Archer FAQ doc, en.namu.wiki Wind Archer.

Nothing unusual about the stat model otherwise: DEX main, STR secondary, normal archer weighting, no HP-as-damage or crit-capping quirk. Wind Archer has no native buff duration from skills (NamuWiki), though HEXA Storm Bringer adds buff duration when built (MapleStory Wiki).

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating 100% critical rate as the point to stop stacking crit.
commonMistakes.why: Vicious Shot allows critical rate above 100% and converts critical rate into critical damage during its 30-second window.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rolling an attack speed line on inner ability.
commonMistakes.why: The class reaches the attack speed cap from Agile Bows, Eagle Eye and Albatross Max alone.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: Priority attribution not supported by the cited source: 'Grandis Library tiers it as secondary' for Storm Bringer Boost, and 'Grandis Library tiers Storm Whim as secondary'. The page's own data marks nodes 1-4 primary and nodes 5-6 other ('primary':[0,1,2,3], 'other':[4,5] against a six-entry node list) - there is no secondary assignment for Wind Archer at all. Grandis' legend defines primary as 'Boost Nodes that unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery and are skills that are frequently used', which is exactly why nodes 1-4 (mapping to Mastery Cores 1-4) are all primary.

The HEXA opening order is NOT fabricated. I downloaded the infographic and read it: the first three cells are labelled M4, M1, M2, each set to level 1, exactly as the file reports. Two caveats the file does not state - the fourth cell is also level 1 and is a visibly different node type, and Mastery Core 4 contains both HEXA Storm Whim and Anemoi, so 'Mastery Core 4 to level 1' does not say which skill.
clearedOnInspection: No invented skill or node names. Every name in the file checks out against maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills, which I read through a browser because it 403s plain fetching: boost node groups 1-6 verbatim ('Boost Node/Enhancement Core 1..6'), Mastery Node/Core 1 HEXA Song of Heaven, 2 HEXA Trifling Wind, 3 HEXA Storm Bringer/Fairy Spiral/Monsoon, 4 HEXA Storm Whim/Anemoi, 'Skill Node/Core 1 (Origin) Mistral Spring', 'Core 2 (Ascent) Elemental Tempest', all nine hyper passives with level requirements 140/140/150/150/165/165/180/180/190 exactly as recorded, Vicious Shot (30 sec, crit rate may exceed 100%, crit damage +50% of crit rate at Lv 30), Agile Bows +2 attack speed, Eagle Eye +1, Albatross Max +1, Sylvan Aid no-arrow, Monsoon 3 sec invincibility, Merciless Winds as a real class-specific V skill. The dead HEXA Tracker sheet really does return 410.
